Install the rmoriebricklayer command-line launcher

Source: R/cli.R
instcli.Rd

Writes small launcher scripts into a directory on your PATH so that rmoriebricklayer login, rmbl ask ... and the other verbs of blcli work from any shell. Run it once after installing or upgrading the package. Nothing outside dir is touched, and only when you call this.

Usage

instcli(
  dir = file.path(path.expand("~"), ".local", "bin"),
  name = c("rmoriebricklayer", "rmbl")
)

Arguments

dir

Character scalar, the target directory; default ~/.local/bin. Created (with its parents) if absent.

name

Character vector of command names to install; default both rmoriebricklayer and its short form rmbl (every verb works under either).

Value

The path of the first launcher written (normally rmoriebricklayer), invisibly; the others are written beside it.

Details

On Unix-alikes each launcher is a /bin/sh script (mode 0755) that sets RMBL_PROG to its own name and runs Rscript -e "rmoriebricklayer::blcli()" with the shell's arguments, exiting with the function's status (130 on Ctrl-C). The library this copy of the package is installed in is pinned inside R with .libPaths(), so an R_LIBS set in the shell or in ~/.Renviron cannot make the command run another copy. An existing file or link of the same name in dir is replaced. On Windows a NAME.cmd batch wrapper doing the same is written instead. A message names the files written and, when dir is not on the PATH, says to add it. Re-run it after moving the package to another library.

Errors when the package installation has no launcher in inst/bin (a damaged installation); when dir cannot be created or written, or is not one string; and when name is not a character vector of one or more command names (empty, NA, an empty string or a name with a directory part is refused).

See also

blcli for the verbs.

Examples

# into a scratch folder, so nothing on your PATH changes
d <- file.path(tempdir(), "bin")
p <- instcli(dir = d)
#> Installed /tmp/RtmpMNCs6G/bin/rmoriebricklayer and /tmp/RtmpMNCs6G/bin/rmbl; add /tmp/RtmpMNCs6G/bin to your PATH
list.files(d)
#> [1] "rmbl"             "rmoriebricklayer"
readLines(p)[1:4]
#> [1] "#!/bin/sh"                                                                                        
#> [2] "# rmoriebricklayer: the rmoriebricklayer command line (written by rmoriebricklayer::instcli())"   
#> [3] "# runs the package in /tmp/RtmpMNCs6G/temp_libpath209e553dbad1 (pinned with .libPaths() inside R)"
#> [4] "export RMBL_PROG=rmoriebricklayer"                                                                

# one name only
instcli(dir = d, name = "rmbl")
#> Installed /tmp/RtmpMNCs6G/bin/rmbl; add /tmp/RtmpMNCs6G/bin to your PATH
if (FALSE) { # interactive()
instcli()   # ~/.local/bin/rmoriebricklayer and ~/.local/bin/rmbl
}
